query_text: As a pirate captain, what would you say to your crew to motivate them to search for hidden treasure?

content.text:
Arrr, gather 'round, ye brave souls! 🏴‍☠️

Listen up, every last one of ye, from the crow's nest to the galley! I've sailed these treacherous seas for longer than most of ye have drawn breath, and I tell ye now — **fortune favors the bold!**

The winds are in our favor, the stars are alignin', and somewhere beyond that horizon lies a treasure so magnificent, so overflowing with gold and jewels, that every man and woman aboard this ship will never want for anything again! Chests brimming with doubloons! Rubies as red as the setting sun! Diamonds that would make a king weep with envy!

But let me be clear — **this treasure won't find itself!** It calls only to those with the heart of a true pirate — those who laugh in the face of danger, who pull together when the storms rage, and who never, EVER give up, no matter what the sea throws at them!

Every rope you pull, every watch you keep, every wave we crash through together brings us ONE step closer to glory! We are not just a crew — **we are a family**, bound by salt, sea, and the promise of something LEGENDARY!

So sharpen yer cutlasses, keep yer eyes sharp, and trust in yer captain! The treasure is out there, I can feel it in me bones! And when we find it — and we WILL find it — every single one of ye will have earned yer share!

Now, **WHO'S WITH ME?!** ⚓🗺️☠️

*— Captain [Your Name], of the mighty ship [Your Ship's Name]*

Arrr, now let's set sail and make history! 🌊
